description: Exactness gate: run the inline esm-spec 6.6.5 tests of problems/hjweno_norm_1d_periodic_exact.esm (model HJWenoNormExact, test constant_field_annihilated_exact) at the problem's default resolution (N=64) through each binding's official simulation pathway. The fifth-order HJ-WENO gradient magnitude annihilates a constant field to the bit (|grad(const)| = 0), so the constant state is preserved exactly under u_t = -S*hjweno(u): the assertions pin L2_error(u, 3) = 0 at t=0 and t=1 within 1e-13 and mean(u) = 3. This is the fifth-order companion of godunov_norm_1d_periodic_exact and the cartesian analogue of the gradient_mpas grad(const) = 0 gate; it drives the compound sqrt((D(u,x))^2) through lowering to the seven-region HJ-WENO makearray and confirms the whole WENO-reconstruction + max/min/sqrt Hamiltonian evaluates and integrates. The order-5 accuracy of the same rule on smooth data is gated separately by tests/conformance/convergence/hjweno_norm_1d_eikonal_mms.

scope_excluded.go: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator
scope_excluded.typescript: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator

blocked_upstream_bindings.rust: Rust hangs at every tolerance tried (loosest reltol 1e-6; all three solvers Erk/Bdf/Sdirk wedge). earthsci-ast-rs's diffsol integrator has no dtmin/max-step fail-fast guard, so on this stiff / non-smooth-min-max / large-AST RHS it drives dt->0 without terminating instead of erroring. Julia (Tsit5) and Python (LSODA) solve it. Remove once the Rust solver gains a step guard.
